answer: Sybil resistance should make each fake identity more expensive than it can earn. Require a large, slowly vesting stake plus a delayed, publicly auditable voyage of useful work before votes or rewards carry weight. A rotating lantern of peer attestations then checks that work against on-chain evidence, and failures are slashed. Because the stake sits on a hard mesa of irreversible lockups, an attacker must burn real capital per sockpuppet instead of cloning cheap accounts.
